proposed_facts.reason: Canonical source confirms unchanged-object forwarding in needle-then-Chain order, held-reference-gated discharge, ground/air placement, decrement outside the successful-spawn guard, and terminal stock reset. Chain cleanup separately guards ownership, calls destruction handling and guarded working-state handling, then clears ownership and interruption callbacks. The functionality document agrees.

Canonical needle cleanup nests both discharge and callback-identity testing under the held-reference guard; either matching callback invokes the helper clearing both slots. Without a held reference only stock is reset. Chain cleanup has its own early return and ChainSomething independently guards its article call and numeric write of 2. Neither the proposal nor document assigns an unsupported enum meaning or immediate-deallocation guarantee.
